jobs.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production 2D sprite sheet. Use the reference image as exact identity, detailed hand-painted style, face, brown pigtails, bows, cream/pink dress, brown boots and wooden sword/cyan guard. All poses face RIGHT, same head size and scale. Serious determined face: narrowed eyes and eyebrows tilted down towards center. NO smile except hurt flinch naturally closes eyes. Full body, generous transparent margins and gaps, genuine alpha transparency, NO floor/ground/shadow/backdrop, NO text/grid or motion effects. Exactly SIX frames, THREE columns by TWO rows. A continuous hit-reaction sequence: 1 sudden small startle, shoulders recoil; 2 stronger backward recoil, knees start bending; 3 peak hit with eyes shut and face showing pain, sword dropping slightly; 4 held peak with torso back and one knee buckling; 5 rebalancing forward, opens determined eyes, regains footing; 6 almost recovered guard, still tense. SIX visibly distinct articulated poses, not duplicates. Same character size, consistent boot baseline, natural weight transfer. No blood, no injuries or violent gore.
